chunks: As for those who disbelieve, neither wealth nor children will avail them in the least against God. They are the residents of Hell where they will live for ever.
ai.seo_question: What will not save disbelievers from God's punishment according to Surah Aal-Imran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the futility of worldly assets—wealth and progeny—in averting divine retribution, emphasizing that true salvation relies on faith and righteous deeds rather than material lineage. It serves as a stern warning to the disbelievers, identifying them as the eternal inhabitants of Hellfire, a theme often linked to the concept of *Khulud* (eternity) in the Hereafter. The verse highlights the spiritual bankruptcy of those who prioritize temporal gains over divine accountability.
